questions.stem: In a screw gauge when the circular scale is given five complete rotations it moves linearly by $2.5\ \mathrm{mm}$. If the circular scale has 100 divisions, the least count of screw gauge is _______ mm.
questions.solution:
Pitch $= \frac{2.5}{5} = 0.5\ \mathrm{mm}$
Least count $= \frac{0.5\ \mathrm{mm}}{100} = 0.005\ \mathrm{mm} = 5 \times 10^{-3}\ \mathrm{mm}$

questions.stem: The increase in the pressure required to decrease the volume $(\Delta V)$ of water is $6.3 \times 10^{7}\ \mathrm{N/m^{2}}$. The percentage decrease in the volume is _____. (Bulk modulus of water $= 2.1 \times 10^{9}\ \mathrm{N/m^{2}}$.)
questions.solution:
% Decrease in volume $= \left(-\frac{\Delta V}{V}\right) \times 100\%$
$= \frac{\Delta P}{\beta} \times 100\%$
$= \frac{6.3 \times 10^{7}}{2.1 \times 10^{9}} \times 100\% = 3\%$

questions.stem: The time taken by a block of mass m to slide down from the heighest point to the lowest point on a rough inclined plane is 50 % more compared to the time taken by the same block on identical inclined smooth plane. Both inclined planes are at $45^\circ$ with the horizontal. The coefficient of kinetic friction between the rough inclined surface and block is ______.
questions.solution:
For smooth plane, $a_{1} = g\sin 45^\circ = g/\sqrt{2}$
For rough plane, $a_{2} = g(\sin 45^\circ - \cos 45^\circ) = \frac{g}{\sqrt{2}}(1-\mu)$
It is given that $t_{2} = 1.5\,t_{1}$
So $s = \frac{1}{2}a_{1}t_{1}^{2} = \frac{1}{2}a_{2}t_{2}^{2}$
$\Rightarrow \frac{g}{\sqrt{2}}t_{1}^{2} = \frac{g}{\sqrt{2}}(1-\mu)(1.5t_{1})^{2}$
$\Rightarrow \mu = (1-\mu)(2.25)$
$\Rightarrow \mu = \frac{1.25}{2.25} = \frac{5}{9}$

questions.stem: Two nuclei of mass number 3 combine with another nucleus of mass number 4 to yield a nucleus of mass number 10. If the binding energy per nucleon for the mass numbers 3, 4 and 10 are 5.6 MeV, 7.4 MeV and 6.1 MeV, respectively, then in the process, $\Delta Mc^{2} =$ _______ MeV.
questions.solution:
$\Delta Mc^{2} =$ B.E. of product $-$ B.E. of reactants
$= (10 \times 6.1) - [2 \times (3 \times 5.6) + (4 \times 7.4)]$
$= 61 - 63.2$
$= -2.2\ \mathrm{MeV}$
$\therefore |\Delta Mc^{2}| = 2.2\ \mathrm{MeV}$

questions.topic: System of Particles and Rotational Motion
questions.stem: A solid sphere of mass M and radius R is divided into two unequal parts. The smaller part having mass $M/8$ is converted into a sphere of radius r and the larger part is converted into a circular disc of thickness t and radius $2R$. If $I_{1}$ is moment of inertia of a sphere having radius r about an axis through its centre and $I_{2}$ is the moment of inertia of a disc about its diameter, the ratio of their moment of inertia $I_{2}/I_{1} =$ ______.
questions.solution:
For smaller part : $M_{1} = \frac{M}{8} \Rightarrow V_{1} = \frac{V}{8} \Rightarrow r = \frac{R}{2}$
$\therefore I_{1} = \frac{2}{5}M_{1}r^{2} = \frac{2}{5}\left(\frac{M}{8}\right)\left(\frac{R}{2}\right)^{2} = \frac{MR^{2}}{80}$
For bigger part $\Rightarrow M_{2} = \frac{7M}{8},\ r' = 2R$
$\therefore I_{2} = \frac{M_{2}(2R)^{2}}{4} = \frac{\frac{7M}{8}(4R^{2})}{4} = \frac{7}{8}MR^{2}$
$\therefore \frac{I_{2}}{I_{1}} = \frac{\frac{7}{8}MR^{2}}{\frac{MR^{2}}{80}} = 70$

questions.stem: The two projectiles are projected with the same initial velocities at the $15^\circ$ and $30^\circ$ with respect to the horizontal. The ratio of their ranges is $1 : x$. The value of x is :
questions.solution:
Range $(R) \propto \sin 2\theta$
$\therefore \frac{R_{1}}{R_{2}} = \frac{\sin(2 \times 15)}{\sin(2 \times 30)} = \frac{\frac{1}{2}}{\sqrt{3}/2} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{1}{x}$
$\therefore x = \sqrt{3}$

questions.topic: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
questions.stem: The graph shows variation of stopping potential $V_{0}$ with the frequency $\nu$ of the incident radiation for three photosensitive metals $X_{1}$, $X_{2}$ and $X_{3}$. Which metal will give out electrons with greater kinetic energy, for the same wavelength of incident radiation ?
questions.solution:
We know that $K_{max} = h\nu - \phi$
$\nu \rightarrow$ Same
$\therefore \phi \downarrow \Rightarrow K_{max} \uparrow$
$\therefore$ Ans is $X_{1}$

options.text: All the metals will give out photo electrons with same kinetic energies

questions.stem: A slit of width a is illuminated by light of wavelength $\lambda$. The linear separation between $1^{st}$ and $3^{rd}$ minima in the diffraction pattern produced on a screen placed at a distance D from the slit system is ______.
questions.solution:
Distance between $1^{st}$ & $3^{rd}$ minima $= y_{3} - y_{1}$
$= \frac{3\lambda D}{a} - \frac{\lambda D}{a}$
$= \frac{2D\lambda}{a}$

questions.stem:
A string A of length $0.314\ \mathrm{m}$ and Young's modulus $2 \times 10^{10}\ \mathrm{N/m^{2}}$ is connected to another string B of length and Young's modulus both twice of those of A. This series combination of strings is then suspended from a rigid support and its free end is fixed to a load of mass $0.8\ \mathrm{kg}$. The net change in length of the combination is ________mm.
(radius of both the strings is $0.2\ \mathrm{mm}$ and acceleration due to gravity $= 10\ \mathrm{m/s^{2}}$)
(Mass of both strings is to be neglected as compared to the mass of load)
questions.solution:
Using $\Delta L = \frac{FL}{AY}$
Where $F = Mg = 0.8 \times 10 = 8\ \mathrm{N}$
$\therefore \Delta L_{1} = \frac{8 \times 0.314}{3.14 \times (2 \times 10^{-4})^{2} \times 2 \times 10^{10}} = 10^{-3} = 1\ \mathrm{mm}$
and $\Delta L_{2} = \frac{F(2L)}{A(2Y)} = \frac{FL}{AY} = \Delta L_{1} = 1\ \mathrm{mm}$
$\therefore$ Total extension $= 1 + 1 = 2\ \mathrm{mm}$

questions.stem: One gas of $n_{1}$ mole of molecules at temperature $T_{1}$, volume $V_{1}$, and pressure $P_{1}$, and another gas of $n_{2}$ mole of molecules at temperature $T_{2}$, volume $V_{2}$, and pressure $P_{2}$, are mixed resulting in pressure P and volume V of the mixture. The temperature of the mixture is _______.

An ideal gas undergoes a process maintaining relation between pressure (P) and volume (V) as $P = P_{0}\left(1 + \left(\frac{V_{0}}{V}\right)^{2}\right)^{-1}$, where $P_{0}$ and $V_{0}$ are constants. If two samples A and B (two moles each) with initial volumes $V_{0}$ and $3V_{0}$ respectively undergo above mentioned process and attain same pressure, then the difference at the temperatures of these samples, $T_{B} - T_{A}$ is _________. (R = gas constant)
questions.solution:
For A $\Rightarrow$
$V_{A} = V_{0}$
$\therefore P_{A} = P_{0}\left[1 + \left(\frac{V_{0}}{V_{0}}\right)^{2}\right]^{-1} = \frac{P_{0}}{2}$
$\therefore T_{A} = \frac{\left(\frac{P_{0}}{2}\right)V_{0}}{2R} = \frac{P_{0}V_{0}}{4R}$
For B $\Rightarrow$
$V_{B} = 3V_{0}$
$\therefore P_{B} = P_{0}\left[1 + \left(\frac{V_{0}}{3V_{0}}\right)^{2}\right]^{-1} = P_{0}\left[1 + \frac{1}{9}\right]^{-1} = \frac{9P_{0}}{10}$
$\therefore T_{B} = \frac{\left(\frac{9P_{0}}{10}\right)(3V_{0})}{2R} = \frac{27P_{0}V_{0}}{20R}$
Therefore, $T_{B} - T_{A} = \frac{P_{0}V_{0}}{4R}\left[\frac{27}{5} - 1\right] = \frac{22P_{0}V_{0}}{20R}$
$= \frac{11P_{0}V_{0}}{10R}$

questions.stem: A voltmeter with internal resistance of $x\ \Omega$ can be used to measure upto $20\ \mathrm{V}$. In order to increase its measuring range to $30\ \mathrm{V}$, the required modification is to _______.
questions.solution:
Range of voltmeter $= i_{g} \times R_{V}$
$20 = i_{g}x$ .....(1)
$30 = i_{g}x'$ .....(2)
From (1) & (2)
$\frac{x'}{x} = \frac{3}{2} \Rightarrow x' = \frac{3}{2}x$
$\because$ Resistance should be increased. So extra resistance should be connected in series.
$\therefore$ Extra resistance $= x' - x = \frac{x}{2}$

options.text: connect resistor of $\frac{x}{2}\ \Omega$, in series with voltmeter.
connect resistor of $\frac{x}{2}\ \Omega$, in parallel to voltmeter.
connect a resistor of $x\ \Omega$ in series with voltmeter.
connect resistor of $2x\ \Omega$ in parallel to voltmeter.

questions.stem: Two 4 bits binary numbers, A = 1101 and B = 1010 are given in the inputs of a logic circuit shown in figure below. The output (Y) will be :
A rod of length 10 cm lies along the principle axis of a concave mirror of focal length 10 cm as shown in figure. The length of the image is _______ cm.
questions.solution:
One end of rod is at centre of curvature, so its image will be at centre of curvature
$\therefore v_{1} = -20\ \mathrm{cm}$
For other end $\Rightarrow \frac{1}{v} + \frac{1}{u} = \frac{1}{f}$
$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{v_{2}} + \frac{1}{-30} = \frac{1}{-10}$
$\Rightarrow v_{2} = -15\ \mathrm{cm}$
$\therefore$ Length of image $= |v_{2} - v_{1}| = 5\ \mathrm{cm}$

questions.stem: A parallel plate air capacitor is connected to a battery. The plates are pulled apart at uniform speed v. If x is the separation between the plates at any instant, then the time rate of change of electrostatic energy of the capacitor is proportional to $x^{\alpha}$, where $\alpha$ is _______.
questions.solution:
At any instant, $C = \frac{\epsilon_{0}A}{x}$
$\therefore U = \frac{1}{2}Cv^{2} = \frac{\epsilon_{0}Av^{2}}{2x^{2}}$
$\therefore \frac{dU}{dx} = \frac{\epsilon_{0}Av^{2}}{2}\left(-\frac{1}{x^{2}}\right)\frac{dx}{dt}$     Where $\frac{dx}{dt} = v \rightarrow$ Constant
$\Rightarrow \frac{dU}{dx} \propto \frac{1}{x^{2}} \propto x^{-2}$
$\therefore a = -2$

questions.stem: An insulated wire is wound so that it forms a flat coil with N = 200 turns. The radius of the innermost turn is $r_{1} = 3\ \mathrm{cm}$, and of the outermost turn $r_{2} = 6\ \mathrm{cm}$. If $20\ \mathrm{mA}$ current flows in it then the magnetic moment will be $\alpha \times 10^{-2}\ \mathrm{A\,m^{2}}$. The value of $\alpha$ is _______.
questions.solution:
$m = \int_{r_{1}}^{r^{2}} I(\pi r^{2})\left[\frac{N}{r_{2} - r_{1}} \times dr\right]$
$\Rightarrow m = \frac{NI\pi}{r_{2} - r_{1}}\int_{r_{1}}^{r_{2}} r^{2}dr = \frac{NI\pi}{r_{2} - r_{1}}\left[\frac{r_{2}^{3} - r_{1}^{3}}{3}\right]$
$\Rightarrow m = \frac{200 \times (20 \times 10^{-3})\pi}{0.06 - 0.03} \times \left[\frac{(0.06)^{2} - (0.03)^{2}}{3}\right]$
$\Rightarrow m = 2.64 \times 10^{-2}\ \mathrm{A.m^{2}}$

questions.stem: Consider a circuit consisting of a capacitor $(20\ \mu\mathrm{F})$, resistor $(100\ \Omega)$ and two identical diodes as shown in figure. The resistance of diode under forward biasing condition is $10\ \Omega$. The time constant of the circuit is $\alpha \times 10^{-3}\ \mathrm{s}$. The value of $\alpha$ is ________.
questions.solution:
$R_{eq} = 100 + 10 = 110\ \Omega$
$\therefore$ Time constant $= R_{eq}C = 110 \times 20 \times 10^{-6}$
$= 2.2 \times 10^{-3}$

questions.stem: The voltage and the current between A and B points shown in the circuit are _________.
questions.solution:
$E_{eq} = \frac{\frac{27}{3} + \frac{27}{3} + \frac{27}{3} + \frac{27}{3}}{\frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{3}} = 27\ \mathrm{volt}$
$\frac{1}{r_{eq}} = \frac{4}{3} \Rightarrow r_{eq} = \frac{3}{4}\ \Omega$
$\therefore R_{eq} = 2 + 2 + 2 + r_{eq} = 6 + \frac{3}{4} = \frac{27}{4}$
$\therefore i = \frac{E_{eq}}{R_{eq}} = \frac{27}{\left(\frac{27}{4}\right)} = 4\ \mathrm{A}$
& $V_{A} - V_{B} = 6 \times 4 = 24\ \mathrm{volt}$

questions.stem: A telescope with objective diameter R is used to observe a distant star emitting light of wavelength $500\ \mathrm{nm}$, at a resolution of $5 \times 10^{-7}$ radian. The value of R is ________ cm.
questions.solution:
Reslution angle $(\Delta\theta) = \frac{1.22\lambda}{R}$
$\Rightarrow R = \frac{1.22\lambda}{\Delta\theta} = \frac{1.22 \times 500 \times 10^{-9}}{5 \times 10^{-7}} = 1.22\ \mathrm{m}$
$\Rightarrow R = 122\ \mathrm{cm}$

questions.stem: An unpolarized light is incident on the plane interface of air-dielectric medium shown in figure. If the incident angle is equal to Brewster angle, identify the expression representing reflected wave.
questions.solution: The light is propagating along the positive z-axis and its is reflected from plane then correct phase for reflected light is $kx - kz - \omega t$ and for electric field as the light incident on Brewster angle so the reflected light should be perfectly plane polarized that's why polarization direction should be y-axis so electric field of reflected light contain no z-component.

questions.stem: A 1 kg block subjected to two simultaneous forces $(2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 4\hat{k})\ \mathrm{N}$ and $(3\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 2\hat{k})\ \mathrm{N}$ is moved a distance of 25 m along $(3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j})$ direction. The work done in this process is ________J.
questions.solution:
$\vec{F}_{net} = \vec{F}_{1} + \vec{F}_{2} = \hat{i}(2+3) + \hat{j}(3-1) + \hat{k}(4-2)$
$\vec{F}_{net} = 5\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 2\hat{k} \rightarrow$ Constant
and $\vec{S} = 25 \times \hat{S} = 25 \times \left(\frac{3\hat{i} + 4\hat{j}}{5}\right)$
$\vec{S} = 15\hat{i} - 20\hat{j}$
$\therefore$ Work done $= \vec{F}\cdot\vec{S} = (5)(15) + (2)(-20) + (2)(0)$
$= 75 - 40 + 0$
35 Joule

questions.stem: The surface tension of a soap solution is $3.5 \times 10^{-2}\ \mathrm{N/m}$. The work required to increase the radius of a soap bubble from 1 cm to 2 cm is $\alpha \times 10^{-6}\ \mathrm{J}$. The value of $\alpha$ is ______. $(\pi = 22/7)$
questions.solution:
Work required $= 2 \times T \times \Delta A = 2T\left[4\pi(r_{f}^{2} - r_{i}^{2})\right]$
$= 2 \times 3.5 \times 10^{-2} \times 4 \times \frac{22}{7}[4 - 1] \times 10^{-4}$
$= 264 \times 10^{-6}$ Joule

questions.stem: The velocity of a particle executing simple harmonic motion along x-axis is described as $v^{2} = 50 - x^{2}$, where x represents displacement. If the time period of motion is $\frac{x}{7}\ \mathrm{s}$, the value of x is _______.
questions.solution:
From S.H.M we know that,
$v^{2} = \omega^{2}(A^{2} - x^{2})$
$\therefore$ On comparisian with given equation
$\omega = 1\ \frac{\mathrm{Rad}}{\mathrm{See}}$
$\therefore T = \frac{2\pi}{1} = 2\pi = \frac{x}{7}$
$\therefore x = 14\pi = 14 \times \frac{22}{7} = 44$

questions.stem: A body of mass 2 kg begins to move under the influence of time dependent force $\vec{F} = (2t\hat{i} + 6t^{2}\hat{j})\ \mathrm{N}$, where $\hat{i}$ and $\hat{j}$ are unit vectors along x and y-axis respectively. The power produced by the force at $t = 2\ \mathrm{s}$ is ______W.
questions.solution:
$\vec{a} = \frac{\vec{F}}{m} = \frac{2t\hat{i} + 6t^{2}\hat{j}}{2} = t\hat{i} + 3t^{2}\hat{j}$
$\therefore \vec{v} = \int \vec{a}\,dt = \frac{t^{2}}{2}\hat{i} + t^{3}\hat{j}$
$\therefore$ Power, $P = \vec{F}\cdot\vec{v} = (2t)\left(\frac{t^{2}}{2}\right) + (6t^{2})t^{3}$
$\Rightarrow P = t^{3} + 6t^{5}$
At $t = 2$ sec
$\Rightarrow P = (2)^{3} + 6(2)^{5} = 8 + 6(32) = 200$

questions.stem: An inductor of $10\ \mathrm{mH}$, capacitor of $0.1\ \mu\mathrm{F}$ and a resistor of $100\ \Omega$ are connected in series across an a.c power supply $220\ \mathrm{V}$, $70\ \mathrm{Hz}$. The power factor of the given circuit is 0.5. The difference in the inductive reactance and capacitance reactance is $\sqrt{3}\alpha\ \Omega$. The value of $\alpha$ is ______.
questions.solution:
$\cos\phi = 0.5 \Rightarrow \phi = 60^\circ$
$\therefore \tan 60^\circ = \frac{|X_{L} - X_{C}|}{R}$
$\Rightarrow |X_{L} - X_{C}| = \sqrt{3}R = \sqrt{3}(100)$
$\therefore \alpha = 100$
